body:
The optional lane-owner composition has a checked image recipe but no publication workflow selecting its Python 3.13 base and immutable lane manifest. This adds a separate publisher and PR image check while keeping the existing default publisher byte-identical.

The publisher captures the pushed registry index digest, verifies source/workflow provenance, the amd64 index and attached SBOM, the exact installed closure and existing image checks, then publishes distinct lane aliases and verifies both digest readbacks. Receipts retain partial or uncertain alias effects.

Validation: 66 targeted tests and Ruff pass; the existing ordinary CI profile passed 3,651 tests with 248 skips. Production-toolchain and PostgreSQL coverage remain separate existing CI requirements. An actual optional-image build passed the new verifier, and a wrong manifest hash was refused. Native Sonnet source review is clear. New registry publication and alias readbacks remain unobserved until this workflow runs.

Served work: vuoro#2907. This is public image packaging; no hosted activation or authority switch is included.
